development_variants.v1_unconditional: Always require current compensated evidence within cosine radius .18 of a proposed stored candidate. Archive retained; rejected because stationary identity48.7->25.2% on development.
development_variants.v2_conditional: In raw mode, two CV values >=.12 in a rolling three-window history activate uncertainty. Three consecutive CV<=.09 windows or entering compensated mode clear it. During uncertainty, require current compensated evidence within the normal .18 cosine radius before committing a confirmed candidate. Outside uncertainty preserve existing admission. Recognition of admitted memories bypasses the gate.

shadow: Always-compensated spectral frontend with no admitted/candidate prototype memory; same mixture waveform only; profile/background state remains independent
main_experiment: Same ten cases and paired no-target controls as transition-protocol.json;120 one-second windows;-6dB post-channel current-source/residual
primary: After-change localized repeat identity IoU>=.25 versus current adaptive

one_off: One target at zero-based window66 per120-window stream; all six factories crossed with stationary and stationary-to-slow backgrounds, each of10seeds. Compare adaptive/guarded novel attention and localized attention; no importance/one-shot-learning claim.
